hotspots.name: 上海人民英雄纪念塔
hotspots.anchor_basis: centroid of OpenStreetMap way 47007059 (人民英雄纪念塔); geographic anchor only
hotspots.spatial_model_status: hotspot-visitors-only demand, simultaneous initial population distributed uniformly by pedestrian-edge length over Huangpu Park paths including P20 and its P21 connector parallel to P15 and P22/P23 meeting at J31 and P24 connecting J31 to P13, three monument access portals and the ground-level outer ring, assigned viewing destinations, profile-aware park route choice, common event release and gradual dispersal; P25 and P26 included with their physical access junctions; three-segment P27 trapezoid branch included; northeast perpendicular P28 branch from J33 included
hotspots.basis: all visitors depart at zero and are initially distributed over Huangpu Park paths, all three monument portals including M3, and the outer ground-level monument ring; edge quotas are proportional to full pedestrian-edge length and positions are stratified randomly along each edge with endpoint margins capped at one quarter of short edge lengths; initial ring visitors stay on the ring, initial portal visitors move inward, and park visitors choose a monument entrance; the inner surface ring and OpenStreetMap level=-1/deeper edges remain excluded; P20 is the user-requested straight 2-meter-wide J05-to-J15 park footway with walking-area widths of 4 meters at J05 and 6 meters at J15 (increased from 5 meters after the P22/P23 stress test); P21 is a straight 2-meter-wide connector parallel to P15, from P14 (J27) to the north-to-south 40% point of the complete P20 centerline (J28), with new walking areas initially set to 4 meters; P14 and P20 are split at these physical junctions and all segments remain in the initial population and route-choice scope; the P14 destination weight is divided by usable segment length to preserve the relative weights of the five original physical west-side destination roads; P22 starts at the complete P15 midpoint (J29), runs southeast parallel to the near-J15 straight segment of P17, and terminates at J31; P23 starts at 20% of the full P17 polyline length from J15 (J30), runs southwest parallel to P15, and also terminates at J31; both new footways are 2 meters wide and all three new walking areas are 4 meters wide; P15 and P17 are split at these physical access junctions and all resulting segments are included in initial population and route choice; P24 is the user-requested straight 2-meter-wide connector from J31 southwest to P13 at J32, with equal angles to P22 and P23 at J31; P13 is split at J32, and its destination weight is divided by usable segment length to preserve the original physical-road quota; J31 is rebuilt as a three-arm walking area, and J31/J32 are initially widened to 4 meters; M3 is the manually modeled 2-meter-wide J13-to-J26 entrance on the shorter western outer arc H2; assigned viewing-arc weights, independent west-side dispersal destinations, the event window of 600 to 800 seconds and release delays of 0 to 90 seconds remain engineering assumptions pending calibration; P25 connects J29 to J33 at the full J28-J15 midpoint and P26 connects J21 to J34 at one third of the full J18-J30 polyline length from J18; both are straight 2-meter-wide footways, P20/P17 retain all split segments and the original P17 bend, J29/J21 are rebuilt with four/five arms and all four affected walking areas are widened to at least 4 meters; P27 is the user-confirmed three-segment northeast J34-J35-J36-J30 trapezoid branch: its short base is half the J34-J30 chord, its legs are equal, and its J34-J35 leg is parallel and codirectional with J21-to-J34/P26; the resulting height is approximately 8.376 meters; the original P17b bend is retained, so the road loop is an approximate trapezoid; all new segments are 2 meters wide, J30/J34 are rebuilt with four arms, and J35/J36 are real two-arm corner junctions with walking areas initially widened to 4 meters; J34 is subsequently widened to 5 meters after its 4-meter all-movements pedestrian stress test stalled, while J30/J35/J36 remain at 4 meters; P28 is a straight 2-meter-wide northeast branch from J33 to the free endpoint J37, perpendicular to J15-J28 and half of the complete junction-to-junction J15-J13/P16 centerline length (approximately 17.254 meters); J33 is rebuilt as a four-arm walking area with at least 4-meter width, while J37 is a one-arm pedestrian dead end
